canonical_definition:
What it is. Across the definitions, this instrument is described as a benchmark dataset for aspect-based sentiment analysis built from restaurant reviews in multiple languages and used to evaluate cross-lingual performance in end-to-end ABSA. One paper specifies that it includes real user restaurant reviews in English, Spanish, French, Dutch, Russian, and Turkish.

What it is claimed to measure. In the papers, papers use this dataset to measure aspect-based sentiment analysis. Its reported measurement links converge on a single behavioral indicator, Aspect-based sentiment analysis, and no constructs are linked to it.

Space of uses. The observed usage frames it as an evaluation dataset for a proposed framework rather than alongside other named instruments. Papers describe evaluating on SemEval-2016 to assess cross-lingual performance in end-to-end ABSA, and no other measurement instruments are linked to it.
